|strategy=By [mailto:zube@eagle.cc.ukans.edu Nick Zube]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/tatooine/dark/small/benquadinarospodracer.html</ref>

Ah, Ben Quadinaros. He's everyone's favorite big-headed alien. And now his Podracer can be your ticket to victory in the [[Boonta Eve Podrace (Dark){{!}}Boonta Eve Podrace]].

While it may be eclipsed by sleeker machines like [[Sebulba's Podracer]], Ben Quadinaros' common Podracer is not only easier to get a hold of, but its ability almost does [[Sebulba]] one better at messing with your opponents. This racer not only adds 1 to each of your race destinies, but it can also turn the tables on your opponent by exchanging race destinies. Sure, you have to lose 2 Force to do it, but hey, if you win the Podrace, you'll get your expense back, with interest. [[Ben Quadinaros' Podracer]], then, is a deadly weapon against [[Anakin Skywalker]], who loves to fix his race destinies in advance. If you're stuck with a low-destiny card, you can laugh in Ani's face and steal his, instead.

But there are sneakier ways to use this card. For example, if you just drew a great character for Podrace destiny, use Ben to switch it with your opponent, then use [[Podracer Collision]] to take the character into your hand &#150; leaving your opponent without a race destiny for the turn!

For a walking pear, Ben Quadinaros sure is a sneaky fellow.

Set up the perfect juicy destiny for you to steal &#150; and a lemon for your opponent.
